title: C30 context selected the stale C24 upgrade transition

reproduction.observed: The first ABI-3 C30 context bound the generic Factorio 2.1 profile's historical 3.2.1-to-3.2.2 transition instead of the required exact 3.2.2-to-3.2.3 C30 transition.

root_cause.summary: The target-line profile combined stable engine identity with release-specific upgrade authority. Context creation copied that mutable historical default verbatim, so later releases on the same Factorio line inherited the wrong baseline and fixture.

regression_propositions: the ReleaseRecord optionally binds an exact typed from-version, to-version, and upgrade fixture
context materialization projects release-specific upgrade authority over the stable target-line profile
the projected profile's to-version equals the candidate release
the projected baseline exists on the same Factorio target
environment-locks.json binds the exact staged target-profile.json digest
C30 selects only the exact 3.2.2-to-3.2.3 transition while C24 calibration retains 3.2.1-to-3.2.2

closure.proof_required: a new immutable C30 context whose target profile binds 3.2.2 to 3.2.3, followed by the exact upgrade measurement and complete candidate qualification
